tweets.text:
8 years ago I was lost

Failed at school
No degree
No network
No help
No safety net
Working a job I hate

Now, I'm living a life that I couldn't even imagine

I sacrificed absolutely everything, but I know it was a shot in the dark, and I wouldn't be he without luck

You can do everything and die in the journey. Belive me I saw it

In those 8 years I met a lot of people more intelligent, disciplined, hard-working and creative than me

One by one, the radio silence set in for a lot of them

It's hard. Only the ones who really give their everything to trading/investing understand how soul-crushing this thing can be and how hard it's to survive

"On a long enough timeline, the survival rate for everyone drops to zero"

Don't let people fool you, luck is everything

You need to give your everything in order to have a 0.01% chance to get lucky

Every human being on earth is irrevocably called to discover what they are good at

it's a fight worth fighting, so, always try

Who knows, maybe luck will smile on you.

tweets.text:
There's always a reason not to buy the bottom and always a reason not to sell the top. Some headline, some technical break, something that makes hesitation feel rational in the moment.

That doubt tends to show up exactly when conviction is hardest to hold, not randomly. Bottoms feel like they can always go lower, tops feel like they can always go higher.

That is how the psychology works in markets. It is good to be aware of this and check yourself from time to time.

Also important to make plans while the market is boring. Because when things get crazy, in either direction, it will be harder to make rational decisions.
